- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py
  Line or code reference: _inject_token_into_url (lines 3040-3052), _resolve_origin_url (lines 3055-3084), _run_git (lines 3007-3021)
  Problem: _resolve_origin_url now embeds GH_TOKEN into HTTPS clone URLs. _clone_for_memory_branch passes this token-bearing URL to git clone at line 3090, which writes it into the clone target's .git/config. _run_git's exception message at line 3017 formats git args including the URL, exposing the token in error output.
  Why it fails at runtime: The token persists on disk in .git/config files and appears in exception messages. The per-process http.extraHeader auth (removed from _git_subprocess_env) was the safe alternative. A clone failure dumps the token into CI logs.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh
  Line or code reference: _memory_force_tick_remote_url (line 586), removal of _memory_git wrapper (was lines 594-607)
  Problem: _memory_git and its per-process http.extraHeader authentication wrapper were deleted. _memory_force_tick_remote_url now returns https://x-access-token:TOKEN@host/repo. All git clone, push, and ls-remote calls now use token-bearing URLs.
  Why it fails at runtime: Token is embedded in remote URLs, visible in process listings, and written to temporary .git/config files. memory_ensure_branch at line 151 now calls bare git ls-remote on a token-free origin, and at line 180 calls bare git push on a token-free origin, which will fail authentication.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py
  Line or code reference: emit_context (line 568, for rel in paths), normalize_path (lines 241-245), removal of is_sensitive_target_path
  Problem: is_sensitive_target_path, MAX_TARGET_PATHS (256), and MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES (1024) were deleted from the module. normalize_path no longer filters sensitive paths. emit_context now iterates raw paths directly without calling normalize_path, statting and potentially reading files whose paths were previously rejected.
  Why it fails at runtime: A path list containing .git/config, .env, .npmrc, or .aws/credentials would be inlined into the LLM prompt. The unbounded iteration also allows arbitrarily large path lists to cause excessive filesystem access and prompt growth with no file-count cap.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh
  Line or code reference: Line 1989
  Problem: git_with_github_auth was removed from scripts/gh_helpers.sh, but line 1989 calls it without a command -v guard.
  Why it fails at runtime: The review-blocked judge-fix path raises "command not found" at line 1989. The push never runs, the fix commit sits local only, and the autofix retry flow cannot reset.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

  Why it fails at runtime: Python raises ImportError during test collection for the entire module. Every test in test_targeted_file_context.py is dead code.
